name: pi-spaces-help-site
description: Next.js 16 + React 19 Help System, 6-Stage Multiplayer Space-Chat & AdminSpaces Portal for https://spaces.eibrain.org

scripts.test:production: npm run build && PI_SPACES_TEST_NEXT=1 node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern='4. Next' tests/help-site.test.ts
scripts.docker:test: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile test run --rm --build spaces-help-test
scripts.docker:dev:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile dev up -d --build spaces-help-dev
scripts.docker:dev:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile dev logs -f spaces-help-dev
scripts.docker:nano:build: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile nano build swarm-nano
scripts.docker:nano:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile nano up -d --build swarm-nano
scripts.docker:nano:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile nano logs -f swarm-nano
